## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Find this writer's published Substack posts by words in the title or subtitle. Also returns recent: the newest titles, subtitles and slugs, so you can judge a match by meaning when the words differ. Pass publicationId from list_my_newsletters when the post is on one newsletter. Do not put a newsletter name in query. Zero matches is a success with an empty posts list. hasRecordingTranscript is true when the post has a live, video or podcast recording whose transcript get_my_posts returns with includeTranscripts: true.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `integer` | No | Max matches to return, newest first (default 15, max 30) Min 1. Max 30. Default `15`. |
| `publicationId` | `integer` | No | Limit to one newsletter. Use a publicationId from list_my_newsletters. |
| `query` | `string` | Yes | Words from the title or subtitle they named Min length 1. Max length 200. |
